_comment: Crafted. Three secrets covering both halves of secret_unused and its negative control: cc/prod/db was accessed two days before the reference date (no signal), cc/legacy/api-key was last accessed in 2025 (old), and cc/never-used has NO LastAccessedDate at all (absent). LastAccessedDate is returned by ListSecrets itself, so the detector never needs DescribeSecret — which the spike policy does not grant. Note AWS reports LastAccessedDate truncated to the day.
